question: Who has been appointed as the Secretary of the Department of Legal Affairs, Ministry of Law and Justice? (March 2025)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Anju Rathi Rana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Dr. Anju Rathi Rana has been appointed as the Secretary of the Department of Legal Affairs, Ministry of Law and Justice, becoming the first woman to hold this position.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Rana was previously serving as Additional Secretary in the Department of Legal Affairs and has extensive experience in legal administration.**
 
• She represented India in international forums such as the BRICS Ministers of Justice Meeting, focusing on legal reforms and gender representation in the judiciary.
 
• Her appointment as the first woman Law Secretary is a significant step towards gender diversity in senior government roles.
 
• She will play a key role in shaping legal frameworks and guiding judicial and legislative initiatives within the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Department of Legal Affairs__

 __
 
• It is part of the Ministry of Law and Justice, responsible for overseeing legal matters related to the government and providing legal advice on various issues.
 
 
 
• BRICS Ministers of Justice Meeting__
 __
 
• It is a platform for legal and judicial cooperation among BRICS nations (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa), focusing on areas like legal reforms and justice system collaboration.
 
 
 
• Gender Diversity in Judiciary__
 
 
• Refers to increasing the representation of women in the judiciary and legal positions, ensuring diverse perspectives and enhancing gender equality in legal decision-making.
